# CAP.1 — capstone gap analysis (whole-build, fresh-context verdicts)

**Stacked on:** `svitali/harnessharness-s6.4` (PR #96) · **Do not merge — operator-controlled**

## Summary

The independent whole-build gap analysis. All 66 canonical requirement
ids (`R-2\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+[a-z]?`) were judged against
`spec/CANONICAL_SPEC.md` from the composed tree at the chain tip —
**verdicts recorded and committed (`efd71f5`) before any
`docs/build/runs/*` ledger was opened**, so per-ticket self-reports
could not contaminate the verdicts.

**Verdict roll-up:** 29 MET · 6 MET-DIFFERENTLY · 29 PARTIAL ·
0 MISSING · 2 AT-RISK-INTEGRATION.

## What landed

- `docs/build/COVERAGE_MATRIX.csv` — one row per requirement id
  (66/66); fixed column set; concrete `path:line`/test/ADR evidence on
  every MET and MET-DIFFERENTLY row.
- `docs/build/CAPSTONE_GAP_ANALYSIS.md` — method + commands, roll-ups
  by verdict and by family, the seam hunt (S1–S8), and the top-gap
  table with a routing decision for each.
- `docs/adr/ADR-0326` — the verdict discipline and routing decisions
  (D1–D5); `docs/adr/README.md` regenerated by `adr-index.sh`.

## The load-bearing findings

1. **R-2.8.4 AT-RISK-INTEGRATION — the egress mediator is built but
   never invoked.** `EgressMediator` has no production caller — only
   `hh-env/tests/egress_mediation.rs` drives it; the dispatch path
   fail-closes `PreconditionDomain::Network` before mediation.
   → fix in CAP.3 (DF-S2.4-1).
2. **R-2.4.1 AT-RISK-INTEGRATION — the context builder is never driven
   on a live run.** `AssemblerPort`'s only production impl is the
   `KernelAssembler` pass-through; `hh_context::assemble` is reachable
   only from tests. → fix in CAP.3 (DF-S2.8-1).
3. **R-2.10.3 — an honestly-measured exemplar cannot close.**
   `AUDIT_FIELD_MAX_BYTES = 512` refuses `measurement.experiment.closed`
   at exemplar scale; a contract-shape ruling is owed.
   → fix in CAP.3 (DF-S3.12b-1).

Everything else routes through existing `DEFERRALS.md` rows or
GATE-ACCEPT: **zero new deferral rows were required** — every gap
traces to an open row with a named owner and verification path.
